US Senators Challenge Legality of Trump's Russian Diesel Deal

A bipartisan group of six U.S. senators has challenged the legality of the Trump administration's decision to allow Russian diesel imports. The senators stated that the administration failed to consult with Congress or provide a required legal explanation for the decision. They are calling for the administration to immediately reverse its course on the plan.
